youtube.title: Mittens' Baby Animals! (POUNCE!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🐣 POUNCE! Mittens the cat pounced so fast that all the baby animals ran off to hide! Can you help Mittens find them?

Mittens meets 6 baby animals and learns their names: a baby cow is a calf, a baby duck is a duckling, a baby sheep is a lamb, a baby dog is a puppy, a baby pig is a piglet and a baby owl is an owlet! Each baby shows up in its own home (the farm, the pond, the park and the night sky) and you hear the REAL sound it makes. Then sing along with Mittens, and stay till the end, because one more tiny baby is hiding nearby! 🐾

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 6 baby animal names: calf, duckling, lamb, puppy, piglet and owlet
✔️ Match each baby to its grown-up animal
✔️ Hear the real sound each animal makes
✔️ Sing a baby animals song with Mittens!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Mittens!
0:04 POUNCE! Oh no!
0:09 Let's find the baby animals!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Who is that, so tiny?
